advisory.finding: The new completion-verifier recording surface (`record_completion_verdict`, signs the reusable attestation + emits the COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar) was added to the CLI adapter (`_verify_completion`, with a `--no-sign` opt-out) and the MCP adapter (`verify_completion` tool, records unless read-only), but the sibling LIBRARY adapter `rebar.llm.verify_completion` was NOT updated to record. A programmatic caller of `rebar.llm.verify_completion` therefore gets an attested PASS that is never signed/recorded, so a later same-ref close still fires a duplicate billable verifier run — the very reuse gap this change closes on the other two surfaces. This diverges from the stated symmetry with `review_plan`, whose library surface `rebar.llm.review_plan(sign=True, emit_sidecar=True)` performs the recording inside the library entry point.
